findings.title_text: Ledger scrutiny indicators on one expense ledger: 1 round-sum entry
limits_text: Each indicator is a structural, entry-level fact only; it is not, by itself, evidence of a wrong classification, a disallowable expense or a TDS default -- the ledger's own name and nature still need the CA's own reading, never a keyword match on the ledger name.
A round or large entry, one near year end, or a cash-paid share, can all have an entirely ordinary explanation (a lump annual payment, a year-end provision, a genuinely cash-heavy trade).
ask_client_text: For each flagged ledger, confirm the nature and supporting document for the large/round-sum/last-days entries listed.
